from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LiabilityRecord(BaseModel):
    """A specific liability figure extracted from a single company's filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company or entity filing the report")
    label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line-item label as written (e.g., 'Total Current Liabilities', 'Total Liabilities')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the liability reported")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency of the reported amount, e.g., USD")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    liability_records: list[LiabilityRecord]
